description: Scrape property listings from Realtor.com. Search by location for sale, rent, or sold properties, or provide direct property URLs.

endPage.description: Maximum search result pages to scrape per search (1-20). Each page has up to 42 properties.
endPage.title: Maximum Pages

maxItems.description: Maximum number of property listings to scrape (1-500).
maxItems.title: Maximum Properties

mode.description: Type of property search — for sale, for rent, or recently sold.
mode.title: Search Mode

scrapeDetails.description: Fetch each property's detail page for full description, schools, tax history, listing history, environmental risk data, and more. Disable for faster runs with only search-level data.
scrapeDetails.title: Scrape Full Details

search.description: City and state to search for properties (e.g., 'Houston, TX', 'San Francisco, CA', 'Miami, FL').
search.sectionDescription: Enter a location and choose a search mode. At least one of Search Location or Start URLs is required.
search.title: Search Location

startUrls.description: Direct Realtor.com property detail URLs or search page URLs. Paste URLs from your browser.
startUrls.sectionDescription: Provide Realtor.com URLs directly instead of or in addition to location search.
startUrls.title: Start URLs

title: Realtor.com Property Scraper
